article.title: UK rejects Jamaica’s historic demand for reparations for slavery
article.author: Editor
article.content: The UK government has firmly rejected this Monday Jamaica’s demand for financial reparations for its role in the transatlantic slave trade, as a Jamaican delegation formally requested £10 billion in compensation from King Charles III. The post UK rejects Jamaica’s historic demand for reparations for slavery appeared first on MR Online .
